judul_en: Why does cutting onions make you cry?

adegan.vo: [curious] Kenapa motong bawang | bikin nangis? | {p0}A, pedas? | {p1}B, ada gas? | {p2}C, cuma sugesti?
adegan.vo_en: [curious] Why does cutting onions | make you cry? | {p0}A, it's spicy? | {p1}B, there's a gas? | {p2}C, it's all in your head?

param_en.judul: Why do onions make you cry?

adegan.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | {jawab}B, GAS! | [excited] Bawang punya | {besar}senjata kimia! | [whispers] Dan ada bawang yang nggak bikin nangis... | {teaser}di akhir video.
adegan.vo_en: [excited] The answer... | {jawab}B, GAS! | [excited] Onions have | {besar}a chemical weapon! | [whispers] And there's an onion that won't make you cry... | {teaser}at the end of the video.

adegan.vo: [curious] Begini prosesnya: | {l0}saat dipotong, sel bawang pecah. | {l1}Enzimnya mengubah zat belerang... | {l2}jadi gas pemicu air mata. | {l3}Gas itu sampai ke mata, | [surprised] dan air mata keluar | untuk membilasnya!
adegan.vo_en: [curious] Here's how it works: | {l0}when cut, onion cells burst. | {l1}Enzymes turn sulfur compounds... | {l2}into a tear-triggering gas. | {l3}The gas reaches your eyes, | [surprised] and tears come out | to wash it away!

adegan.vo: [playful] Mau nggak nangis? | {l0}Dinginkan dulu di kulkas, | {l1}pakai pisau yang tajam, | {l2}dan potong akarnya paling akhir.
adegan.vo_en: [playful] Want to stop crying? | {l0}Chill it in the fridge first, | {l1}use a sharp knife, | {l2}and cut the root end last.

adegan.vo: [mischievously] Dan kejutannya: | {k}enzim pelakunya ditemukan | ilmuwan Jepang tahun dua ribu dua. | [excited] {i0}Sekarang sudah ada bawang hasil pemuliaan | yang nggak bikin nangis, | dijual di Amerika dan Inggris!
adegan.vo_en: [mischievously] And the surprise: | {k}the culprit enzyme was found | by Japanese scientists in <2002=two thousand two>. | [excited] {i0}Now there's a specially bred onion | that doesn't make you cry, | sold in the US and the UK!

adegan.vo: [playful] Bawang memang kecil, | tapi senjatanya kimia! | Kirim ke temanmu | yang selalu nangis di dapur!
adegan.vo_en: [playful] Onions may be small, | but they pack chemical weapons! | Send this to a friend | who always cries in the kitchen!
